Attacks.Name: Greedy wicked claw (2 attacks)
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage Trollish regeneration 10: While a troll is damaged, its rubbery flesh heals 10 hit points at the start of the troll’s turn. It can regenerate five times per battle. If it heals to its maximum hit points, then that use of regeneration doesn’t count against the five-use limit. When the troll is hit by an attack that deals fire or acid damage, it loses one use of its regeneration, and it can’t regenerate during its next turn. Dropping a troll to 0 hp doesn’t kill it if it has any uses of regeneration left.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Increased regeneration
Abilities.Description: Increase the troll’s regeneration dice; the baseline amount a troll regenerates should run about 1/9 of its total hp, but you can go higher to be nasty. Mutant: Fire and acid don’t hurt the troll’s regeneration; lightning does instead. Rending: If both claw attacks hit the same target, the target also takes 10 ongoing damage.

Attacks.Name: Deathly touch
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The target is also weakened until the end of its next turn (–4 attacks and defenses). In addition, the target expends one unused limited trait (a spell, power, or talent with a once-per-battle or daily use, but not magic item powers) of its choice.

Abilities.Name: Vampiric regeneration
Abilities.Description: The vampire regenerates 1 hp per level at the start of each round indefinitely, but it turns to mist if it drops to 0 hp (see below).

Abilities.Name: Mist form
Abilities.Description: Unless it is slain in a manner appropriate for truly killing vampires in the campaign, a vampire that drops to 0 hp drifts away to return and fight some other day.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Vampiric compulsion +15 vs. MD (one enemy; see below)— the target is confused and vulnerable (save ends)

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Limited use
Abilities.Description: The vampire can use vampiric compulsion as a free action only when a nearby enemy attacks the vampire and misses with a natural attack roll of 1–5.

Attacks.Name: Claw
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The vampire spawn can make a fangs attack against the target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Fangs
Attacks.Hit: 7 damage, and a humanoid target is weakened (–4 attack and defenses) until the end of the vampire spawn’s next turn

Attacks.Name: Claws and fangs
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 18+: If the target is staggered, it is also hampered (makes only basic attacks) until the end of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Spear, sword, or club
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 1 damage.

Attacks.Name: Infected bite
Attacks.Hit: 2 damage and 2 ongoing damage, and the crit range for each wererat in the battle against the target expands by 1 (cumulative)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 11+: The target can’t make opportunity attacks until the end of the turn (making it easier for the wererat to move away from the target). Hybrid miss: While in hybrid form, when the wererat makes an opportunity attack with infected bite, it deals damage equal to its level on a miss.

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the wererat is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 5 hp.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Wererats gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Uncanny moves
Abilities.Description: The wererat takes no damage and suffers no effects from attacks that miss. Piercing shriek: Once per battle when the escalation die is 2+ and there are three or more wererats in the battle, a wererat can make a piercing shriek attack as a free action. Usually all the wererats in the battle will do this at the same time.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Piercing shriek +7 vs. MD (the closest nearby enemy)—4 damage

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Miss
Abilities.Description: 2 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ravening bite
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: The werewolf gains a +2 attack bonus (cumulative) to ravening bite attacks until the end of the battle.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Werewolves gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Pack attack
Abilities.Description: When the werewolf attacks a creature that is engaged with one of its allies, the target is vulnerable to that attack.

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the werewolf is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 6 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Sustaining blood
Abilities.Description: When the werewolf hits with a ravening bite attack, it heals 4 hp.

Attacks.Name: Massive claws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The werebear grabs the target. As a standard action, it can make a head chomp attack against an enemy it’s grabbing.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Head chomp (includes +4 grab bonus) vs. AC (one enemy it’s grabbing)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 20 damage.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Werebears gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the werebear is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 20 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Chew on arm
Abilities.Description:
Instead of chomping on a grabbed enemy’s head, the werebear can make an arm crunch attack against an enemy it’s grabbing.

Arm crunch +14 vs. AC—70 damage, and the target is weakened until it regains maximum hit points

Attacks.Name: Claws and bite
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage First natural 11+ each turn: The weretiger can make a second claws and bite attack as a free action. Second natural 11+ each turn: The weretiger can make a third claws and bite attack as a free action if the escalation die is 3+.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Springing strike
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: When an enemy engages the weretiger, if weretiger isn’t already engaged, it can make a springing strike attack against that enemy as an interrupt action before the attack.

Abilities.Name: Bestial fury (hybrid form only)
Abilities.Description: Weretigers gain a bonus to damage equal to the escalation die (champion: double the die; epic: quadruple the die).

Abilities.Name: Unnatural vigor (hybrid or animal form only)
Abilities.Description: When the weretiger is not staggered at the start of its turn, it heals 24 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Stymie
Abilities.Description: When the weretiger hits with a springing strike attack, the target pops free from it and can’t take any more actions that turn unless it succeeds on a save.

Attacks.Name: Soul bite
Attacks.Hit: 36 psychic damage, and the target is affected by wendigo’s hunger (save ends) Wendigo’s hunger: Until the target saves, roll 1d6 at the start of each of its turns. It takes the corresponding action for its full turn instead of its normal turn: 1–2: The target takes 10 damage as it bites itself. 3–4: The target makes a basic attack against its nearest or most vulnerable ally (moving to that target if necessary). 5–6: The target attacks the wendigo if it can; otherwise, it does nothing.

Attacks.Name: Wind claw (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: After the attack the wendigo can teleport somewhere nearby as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The wendigo can walk on the wind. It is not a graceful flyer, but it moves as fast as the wind that carries it. Nearby creatures can see its feet blazing with fire as it runs.

Abilities.Name: Spirit form
Abilities.Description: The wendigo has resist damage 16+ to all damage except thunder damage. A wendigo spirit can move through solid objects but it can’t end its movement inside them.

Abilities.Name: Unseen horror
Abilities.Description: The wendigo is invisible to far away creatures. When the wendigo attacks, if its target couldn’t see it at the start of its turn, the wendigo gains a +2 attack bonus that turn.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Curse of the wendigo
Abilities.Description:
If a creature subject to wendigo’s hunger drops itself (through biting) or an ally (with a basic attack) to 0 hp or lower, that creature also begins making last gasp saves. Failing the fourth last gasp save turns the creature into a raving

cannibal; it loses all its normal abilities and becomes an NPC until the PCs find a way to restore their ally (at GM’s discretion).

Attacks.Name: Latching bite (one staggered enemy, or one enemy making saving throw rolls)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: Add another ravenous cannibal mook to the mob (it must have been hiding somewhere nearby, or wasn’t really dead when it dropped earlier in the battle).

Attacks.Name: Icy claws (3 attacks, each against a different nearby enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 50 cold damage Frostburn: If all three attacks hit, each nearby enemy takes 4d10 fire damage.

Attacks.Name: Close: Flame blizzard (1d6 nearby or far away enemies, but not more than esc. die)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered until the end of its next turn.

Attacks.Name: Close: Horrific gaze (one nearby or far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 120 psychic damage, and the target is confused (save ends) Fourth failed confusion save: The target slips into madness and becomes a cannibal cultist or wendigo or some other terrible demon-thing of the GM’s or player’s choice in 2d10 hours.
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 60 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: The elder wendigo can walk on the wind. It is not a graceful flyer, but it moves as fast as the wind that carries it.

Abilities.Name: Swirling snow and fog and flame
Abilities.Description: The elder wendigo gains a +5 bonus to all defenses against attacks by far away enemies.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Force of disruption
Abilities.Description: When the elder wendigo scores a critical hit against a target or drops a target to 0 hp or lower, that creature must permanently change one of its icon relationship points to a relationship with a different icon—one of a few that the GM chooses. Alternatively, a point the character already has with one of those icons changes to involve another icon (of the PC’s choice). The demon stares back: Once per round when a nearby or far away enemy attacks the elder wendigo and rolls a natural odd miss, the wendigo can make a horrific gaze attack against that attacker as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Tentacle caress
Attacks.Hit: 12 damage, and the target is vulnerable to psychic damage (save ends)

Attacks.Name: Close: Whispered secrets (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage, and the target’s mind is filled with a delusional scene from its past that depends on the roll
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is confused until the end of its next turn as it sees a foe from its past. Natural odd hit: The target is weakened until the end of its next turn as it remembers a past failure. Rewards of the patron: So long as the attack hits one or more targets, one ally of the prophet’s choice gains a cumulative +1 attack bonus until the end of the battle that increases that ally’s natural attack roll (so a roll of natural 15 becomes a roll of

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: natural 16 with a +1 bonus, or a natural 17 with a +2 bonus, etc.). The ally can choose not to use the bonus.

Abilities.Name: Saw it coming
Abilities.Description: Twice per battle as a free action, the prophet can try to avoid a non-critical attack that hits it. The attacker must reroll the attack roll with a –4 penalty.

Abilities.Name: Knows the angles
Abilities.Description: Twice per battle as a move action, the prophet can teleport to anywhere it can see, or to a location it can’t see but that has the correct geometry and that it has previously prepared (a lair).

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Haruspicy master
Abilities.Description: When an enemy has dropped to 0 hp or lower since the prophet’s last turn, as a quick action it can get a glimpse of the near-future. It grants 1d3 nearby allies a +4 bonus to attacks and to all defenses until the start of its next turn. A special secret: When the prophet makes a whispered secrets attack, it can choose to target only one nearby enemy. If it does, it gains a +4 attack bonus against that enemy and the hit effects are save ends.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Force burp spell
Attacks.Hit: 4 force damage Disengaged: Wibbles gain a +5 bonus to disengage checks. They also don’t remain engaged with their foes and will move every turn in battle. When they fail a disengage check, a wibble moves away anyway.

Abilities.Name: Eruptive blorp
Abilities.Description: When an enemy hits a wibble with a melee attack, it takes force damage equal to its level.

Abilities.Name: Flight
Abilities.Description: Wibbles waft about. They can fly well enough to ignore most wind, but not strong gale winds.

Abilities.Name: Whiff and wibble
Abilities.Description: When a creature makes a non-spell attack against a wibble and rolls a natural 1–2, 1d3 new wibbles are created in the same area. These new wibbles typically melt back into their “parent” at the end of a battle if not destroyed, but sometimes they remain separate and drift off on their own.

Attacks.Name: Sword
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Unless the wight is staggered, the attack also deals 8 ongoing negative energy damage.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Barrow-touch
Abilities.Description: The wight’s attacks against enemies taking ongoing negative energy damage are against PD instead of AC and have an expanded crit range of 18+.

Attacks.Name: Ice-cold ghost blade
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target is also weakened (save ends).

Attacks.Name: Close: Spiraling assault (1d3 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: 10 negative energy damage, and after the attack the wraith teleports to and engages with one target it hit
Attacks.Triggers: Limited use: The wraith can use spiraling assault only when the escalation die is even.

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

Abilities.Name: Ghostly
Abilities.Description: This creature has resist damage 16+ to all damage (including holy damage) except force damage, which damages it normally. A wraith can move through solid objects, but it can’t end its movement inside them.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Drain life
Abilities.Description: The wraith heals half the damage it deals when it hits with a natural 18+ attack roll.

Attacks.Name: Tearing jaws
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The wyvern can make a deadly tail stinger attack during its next turn.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] Deadly tail stinger
Attacks.Hit: 15 damage, and the target takes 10 ongoing poison damage (difficult save ends, 16+)

Abilities.Name: Note
Abilities.Description: Flight

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Escalating poison
Abilities.Description: Add the escalation die to the wyvern’s ongoing poison damage whenever that damage is dealt.

Abilities.Name: Vulnerability
Abilities.Description: holy

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: A critical hit against a zombie drops it to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Eat brains
Abilities.Description: More dangerous zombies don’t try to kill the moving targets before feasting on brains; they keep attacking any enemy they’ve knocked unconscious, rolling attacks against the helpless enemy until it’s dead.

Attacks.Name: Smash
Attacks.Hit: 20 damage, and the zombie can only attack using gutburst during its next turn
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: Both the zombie and its target take 2d6 damage.

Attacks.Name: [Special trigger] C: Gutburst vs PD (up to 2 nearby enemies)
Attacks.Hit: The target takes 3 ongoing acid damage from a spray of stinking zombified gut juice. The zombie takes 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: The first time an enemy crits the zombie, the beast must roll a save. If it succeeds, it takes normal crit damage. If it fails, it drops to 0 hp. A second crit just drops the thing.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Ghastly thrashing
Abilities.Description: When the zombie beast is first staggered, it makes a thrash attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Thrash +7 vs. PD (each enemy engaged with it)—15 damage

Attacks.Name: Club or club-like fists
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and its target take 4d6 damage!

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: A critical hit against a zombie drops it to 0 hp.

Attacks.Name: Iron-hard hands
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and its target take 1d6 damage.

Abilities.Name: Hand of the fallen
Abilities.Description:
When a melee attack drops one or more Silver Rose mooks, the hand of one of those zombies ends up severed from its owner and latched onto a nearby enemy. The afflicted creature is vulnerable to all attacks until the hand is

removed, which takes a standard action by that creature or an ally next to them.

Abilities.Name: Shot to the head
Abilities.Description: When an attack drops this zombie and it had 2, 4, or 6 hp remaining, the attack deals the same amount of damage to another member of the mob. If this zombie has any other number of hit points left? No hit to the head.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Curse of failure
Abilities.Description: Each round, one zombie mook in the Silver Rose mob can make a curse attack as a quick action.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: C
Abilities.Description: Curse +4 vs. MD (one nearby enemy)—The target is weakened until the start of the zombie’s next turn. Mob rule: The curse gains an attack bonus equal to the number of Silver Rose zombies in the battle.

Attacks.Name: Club or club-like fists
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and its target take 6d10 damage!

Abilities.Name: Headshot
Abilities.Description: A critical hit against a giant zombie mook deals triple damage instead of the normal double damage for a crit.

Abilities.Name: Double-strength mook
Abilities.Description: The giant zombie mook counts as two 9th level mooks when you are building battles.

Attacks.Name: Flailing fists
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: Both the zombie and the target take 3d10 damage.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Mouthless cry (1d3 closest nearby enemies)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target takes 20 psychic damage.

Abilities.Name: Death spasms
Abilities.Description: When a headless zombie drops to 0 hp, it flails with its fists and makes a mouthless cry attack as a free action before it dies.

Abilities.Name: Inevitable hunger
Abilities.Description: When a creature tries to affect the zombie’s attack, such as forcing a reroll or applying a penalty, it must roll a normal save; on a failure, the effect is negated.

Abilities.Name: Nastier: Baleful aura
Abilities.Description: While nearby a headless zombie, when a creature would heal, it only heals half the normal hit points. Necrotic supremacy: When the escalation die increases to 6, each headless zombie in the battle is restored to maximum hit points, including the dead ones.

Attacks.Name: Headbutt
Attacks.Hit: 10 damage, and the target moves down 1d6 points in initiative order

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Ray of wasted time (1d3 nearby enemies or one far away enemy)
Attacks.Hit: 5 psychic damage, and 5 ongoing psychic damage
Attacks.Triggers: Natural 16+: The target also moves down 1d6 points in initiative order.

Abilities.Name: A moment of silence
Abilities.Description: The escalation die does not increase the round after a dawn zorigami drops to 0 hp.

Abilities.Name: On pause
Abilities.Description: A creature that is reduced to a negative initiative count in a battle involving one or more dawn zorigami moves forward in time, reappearing somewhere nearby in a number of minutes equal to their negative initiative count, presumably long after the current battle is over. The target may be confused by this effect, since the ways of zorigami are mysterious.

Attacks.Name: Multi-geared mace
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit or miss: The target can’t use the bonuses and powers of one of its randomly determined true magic items until the end of the battle.

Attacks.Name: Ranged: Spray of sharpened gears (1d3 nearby enemies or one far away enemy)
Attacks.Triggers: Miss: 8 damage.

Abilities.Name: Lethal parries
Abilities.Description: When an enemy engaged with the apex zorigami misses it with an attack, the apex zorigami rolls a normal save; on a success, it can make a multi-geared mace attack as a free action.

Abilities.Name: Take five
Abilities.Description: The escalation die does not increase the round after an apex zorigami is staggered or drops to 0 hp.

Attacks.Name: Arm full of blades (2 attacks)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The target is hampered (save ends). Natural odd hit: The target can’t heal using its own recoveries (save ends). Natural 1–5: The dusk zorigami can make a shaking the hourglass attack against a single target as a free action.

Attacks.Name: Close: Shaking the hourglass (each nearby enemy not engaged with a zorigami)
Attacks.Hit: 20 psychic damage, and the target is vulnerable (save ends)
Attacks.Triggers: Natural even hit: The escalation die increases by one. Natural odd hit: The escalation die decreases by one.

Abilities.Name: The ticking clock of its own mortality
Abilities.Description: While it’s staggered, the dusk zorigami uses the escalation die.
